mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and 67 degrees at Verona Community Park under a Waning Crescent moon. Expect a low of 61 degrees tonight with rain predicted for the overnight hours.

The City of Verona has updated its engineering reports following recent City Council meetings. Additionally, the Senior Center is inviting residents to sign up for free tri-shaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail.

There is plenty to do, with the Dane County Farmers Market happening today. You can also catch live music today at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the Verona Ice Arena is hosting a free Girls Try Hockey event.
In our weekly police report, on July 31, a driver was arrested for an O W I and cited for suspended registration after an officer stopped the vehicle for equipment violations.
Today's flavor is the delicious Andes Mint Avalanche. The shop is currently closed but will open tomorrow at 10 AM, when the flavor will switch to Snickers Swirl.
